_comment: Every correction we have made to a published figure, with the date. A site that publishes statistics should also publish the ones it got wrong. Hand-maintained: each entry is added when a bug is fixed, not generated.

corrections.what_showed: FII and DII showed 'Rs 0 Cr' on every close message
corrections.what_was_right: NSE's netValue is already in crore; the code divided by 1e7 again, turning 7,831 crore into 0.0008. A missing value also printed as zero.
corrections.fixed: Removed the second division; a missing value now stays missing and the line is skipped.

corrections.what_was_right: The number shown was the largest open-interest strike, not max pain. The two are different figures.
corrections.fixed: Max pain is now computed as the strike where option buyers collectively lose least. The largest-OI strike is kept separately under its own name.

corrections.what_showed: Two different PCRs in one close message - 1.03 near the top, 0.77 lower down
corrections.what_was_right: The first was summed across all expiries, the second was one expiry. Both were correct; showing both without saying so was not.
corrections.fixed: One PCR per message, with its expiry stated.

corrections.what_showed: 'Market Open' on a message sent at 00:45 IST
corrections.what_was_right: The market had been shut for ten hours. The label was chosen by clock hour, not by the session.
corrections.fixed: The label checks the session window (09:15-15:30 IST, weekdays) and falls back to 'pre-open note'.

corrections.what_showed: A market ticker across the top of the site showing Nifty, Sensex, VIX, FII and DII
corrections.what_was_right: The figures came from the last pipeline run, not a live feed, but sat in the position and style of a live tape.
corrections.fixed: Ticker removed. The same figures appear on the Today card with their date.

corrections.what_showed: An option-chain section headed '2026-11-17 expiry' on 18 November
corrections.what_was_right: That expiry had settled the previous day. Showing it unlabelled read as current positioning.
corrections.fixed: A settled expiry is now marked '(settled - this is not current positioning)'.

corrections.what_showed: PCR 2.12 quoted for an expiry holding 0.0% of open interest
corrections.what_was_right: A ratio computed on almost no open interest is noise, not positioning.
corrections.fixed: Expiries are ranked by open-interest share, the share is printed on each line, and anything under 0.5% is dropped.

corrections.what_showed: A put-call ratio on the site dated 2026-10-28
corrections.what_was_right: Nothing converted the nightly F&O bhavcopy into the open-interest history the PCR is built from. The chain froze at 28 October while fresh files kept arriving.
corrections.fixed: scripts/aggregate_oi_history.py closes the gap; PCR now tracks the latest session.

corrections.what_was_right: A range that wide tells a reader nothing, and 'direction flat' beside it is worse than silence.
corrections.fixed: Replaced with what Nifty has actually done: 90% of 21-session moves fell between -5.6% and +7.7% (n=2,446, 2016-2026). No model, no direction claim.

corrections.what_showed: A momentum ranking card with no stocks in it
corrections.what_was_right: The builder was never scheduled. It had been run by hand once, so its history held a single day and it had nothing to compare.
corrections.fixed: Added to the nightly pipeline. It fills in as history accumulates.

corrections.what_showed: A 'Promoter' card where every value was an em dash
corrections.what_was_right: The card read fields that do not exist in the file. The data was there; the labels pointed at nothing.
corrections.fixed: Reads the real fields. The pledge column was removed rather than left empty, because no free source reports it.

corrections.what_was_right: A guard that restores the script tag compared against an exact string; once the tag carried a version it added a second, unversioned copy. Two sets of observers fought over the same section, which caused the visible flicker.
corrections.fixed: The guard now matches any cards.js tag and collapses duplicates instead of adding one.
